title: Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs has launched Upgraded NYPS 2.0 Portal for Nationwide Participation
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs

Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs has launched Upgraded NYPS 2.0 Portal for Nationwide Participation

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
03 AUG 2026 2:18PM by PIB Delhi

The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs has launched an upgraded version of the National Youth Parliament Scheme (NYPS) web portal, known as NYPS 2.0, on 11
th
 September 2024. Unlike the previous version, which was limited to students of recognized institutions only, NYPS 2.0 is open to all the educational institutions, groups, and citizens across the country.
